items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
items.claim: The pair status union cannot represent a terminal waiting-for-approval state after a denied network turn. Add explicit network_permission_required status/revision coverage for loading and retry tests.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
items.claim: The subtask order introduces the psychiatrist skill and prompt-policy version after prompt/thread work depends on it, and places handoff before later work. Move 24.7 before prompt/thread subtasks or fold it into 24.2; keep 24.6 handoff last.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
items.claim: regeneratePsychiatristResponse() carries only pairId, so stale client state can call a global pair endpoint without active memory/thread/variant enforcement. Scope the helper or route under memory/thread identity.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
items.claim: Reducing a pair to only the latest revision loses the last completed assistant response when a newer Regenerate attempt fails or is stopped. The reducer must carry forward the latest completed response while overlaying regenerate status.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
items.claim: The snapshot stores anchors and hashes but not selected Markdown or exact rendered prompt input, so Regenerate cannot reconstruct the original context after memory edits. Persist selected section text or exact prompt input.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
items.claim: pairId is used in route parameters and filesystem paths, but only threadId and turnId are required to be generated UUID v7 path segments. Add pairId to the opaque UUID/path-segment rule and tests.
